source: Electricity: EPA eGRID2023 Summary Tables (created March 27, 2025), Table 1, subregion total output emission rates, CO2e: RFC West (RFCW, the subregion serving ComEd and Chicago) 916.054 lb/MWh = 0.4155 kg/kWh; U.S. 770.884 lb/MWh = 0.3497 kg/kWh (used when the state has no entry). Note: southern and central Illinois (Ameren) is in SERC Midwest (SRMW, 1,248.6 lb/MWh); the Illinois value assumes a ComEd (northern Illinois) building. For comparison, EIA's State Electricity Profiles 2024 put power generated in Illinois at 510 lb CO2/MWh, lower because Illinois exports much of its nuclear power. Gas: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025, Table 1 (stationary combustion, natural gas): 53.06 kg CO2, 1 g CH4 and 0.1 g N2O per MMBtu; with AR5 global warming potentials (28 and 265, the Hub's Table 11) that is 53.11 kg CO2e per MMBtu = 5.311 kg per therm. Estimates; not verified carbon accounting.
